event_types.description: The whole new list of event types.

items.description: An event type, fyniq.<object>.<event>.v<N>, from the deliverable list of the AsyncAPI catalogue.

reason.description: Why it was paused or disabled, for the people who run it.
examples: The receiver is down for maintenance

state.description: paused or disabled stop deliveries at once; active resumes a paused (verified) endpoint; pending re-verifies a disabled one.

url.description: A new address; the endpoint is pending again until it echoes a challenge.
